title: Web3Sound
tagline: The issue: Giant music streaming platforms take a majority % of the revenue that the artist's content generates. The solution: Use web3 to govern a new streaming app that lets creators earn their fair share from the listeners.
description:
Web3Sound: Empowering Artists in the Decentralized Music Streaming Revolution

Web3Sound is a groundbreaking project developed for the HackFS hackathon. Our vision is to create an open-source music streaming platform that revolutionizes the way artists and creators are compensated for their work. At the core of this platform is the innovative decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) called dApp/dao, which governs the codebase and operation of the platform.

Traditional music streaming platforms have long been criticized for their opaque revenue-sharing models, where artists often receive only a fraction of the revenue generated from their content. With Web3Sound, we aim to disrupt this industry norm by leveraging the power of blockchain technology and Web3 principles.

Our platform provides artists with real-time visibility into the revenue generated by their content. Every transaction and interaction within the platform, from content consumption to revenue distribution, is tracked transparently on the blockchain. This ensures that artists have full transparency and control over their earnings, eliminating the need to rely solely on the platform's reporting.

By utilizing smart contracts and decentralized technologies, Web3Sound ensures that revenue distribution is fair and efficient. The dapp/dao governance structure empowers artists and creators to actively participate in shaping the future of the platform. Decisions regarding revenue distribution, platform fees, and feature developments are made collectively by the community, ensuring a more democratic and artist-centric ecosystem.

Our ultimate goal is to create a platform where artists can thrive financially and creatively. By embracing the principles of decentralization and blockchain technology, Web3Sound aims to establish a new standard for transparency, fair compensation, and artist empowerment in the music streaming industry.

Join us on this exciting journey as we pave the way for a more equitable and transparent future for musicians and content creators. Contribute to the open-source Web3Sound project, participate in the dApp/dao governance, and be a part of the movement that revolutionizes the music industry from the ground up. Together, we can create a world where artists are truly rewarded for their talent and contributions.

how_its_made:
The web3Sound project is a decentralized audio streaming platform that leverages the power of the ceramic network and various other technologies to provide a seamless and secure experience for users and creators. At its core, web3Sound utilizes the ceramic network for decentralized identity and data management.

To get started, users are required to have a ceramic account, which serves as their authentication and profile system within the platform. By connecting their ceramic accounts to the web3Sound dApp, users can securely access the platform and manage their profile information.

Creators play a vital role in the ecosystem, and they can upload their audio files directly to the platform. These audio files are securely stored on web3.storage, a decentralized storage solution that ensures durability and availability of the uploaded content. By leveraging web3.storage, web3Sound guarantees that creators' audio files remain accessible and tamper-proof.

To manage the decentralized data of the platform, web3Sound relies on CeramicDB. This decentralized database solution built on top of the ceramic network enables efficient storage and retrieval of user profiles, audio metadata, and other relevant information. By utilizing CeramicDB, web3Sound ensures that data remains decentralized, immutable, and transparent, enhancing the platform's reliability and security.

The platform also provides a social aspect where users can follow their favorite creators. This functionality allows users to stay updated with the latest audio releases and discover new content from creators they admire.

In the future, web3Sound plans to implement the lit Protocol, an additional layer of security and privacy. With lit Protocol, creators will have the ability to upload private songs that can only be decrypted and streamed by their approved followers. This feature enhances the exclusivity and personalized experience for followers while maintaining the decentralized nature of the platform.

Overall, web3Sound embraces decentralized technologies like the ceramic network, web3.storage, and CeramicDB to create a secure, transparent, and user-centric audio streaming platform that empowers both creators and users in the web3 ecosystem.
